name: Surrender to My Dangerous Boss
overview: Clara, struggling to pay for her mother's medical bills, is forced to work as a hostess in a bar. The powerful Elliot appears and rescues her, bringing her into his world. Amidst a complex web of emotions and a challenging professional environment, they gradually develop feelings for each other. Elizabeth repeatedly schemes to sabotage Clara, attempting to push her out of Elliot's life. With Elliot’s support, Clara slowly finds herself and learns to face life with courage. Ultimately, the two overcome numerous obstacles and find happiness together.
